services.name: Longo Planetarium
services.desc: This summer you can tour the stars and planets or learn about a solar eclipse at the Longo Planetarium! A planetarium show for kids features a young girl named Astra and her dog Sirius. Together they tour constellations and planets. In Mashups, you can also see how galactic smashups trigger monster black holes. The planetarium’s popular show Starlit Nights will feature a live tour of the night sky. These three shows blend cutting-edge technology with immersive storytelling and will be presented beneath the 33-foot-diameter dome to reveal the beauty, science and wonder of the cosmos.
